name: Netflix to Discord Telemetry Console
description: Production telemetry console and automated Gmail-to-Discord forwarder for Netflix verification and household management.

resources.name: Telemetry Snapshot
resources.description: Returns current forwarding configuration, poll status, deduplication window checkpoint, and recent logs in a single JSON payload.

resources.name: Trigger Poll
resources.description: Triggers an on-demand poll of Gmail for Netflix emails and dispatches to configured Discord channels.

resources.name: Discord Webhook Configuration
resources.description: Add or remove Discord webhook destinations.
